strings.name: Léon Marchand
strings.summary: From a Toulouse swimming family, Marchand trained locally before joining Bob Bowman in the US in 2021. Known for medley versatility and underwater skills, he broke Phelps’s 400m medley world record in 2023 and won four individual golds at Paris 2024. He set a 200m medley world record in 2025, becoming a prominent figure in French swimming.
strings.influence.rationale: Multiple Olympic golds and world-class medley performances brought French swimming broad international attention.
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied computer science and trained with Arizona State University’s swimming team.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Four individual Paris golds
strings.highlights.h1.text: Won 200m butterfly, breaststroke, and 200m and 400m individual medley.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Medley world records
strings.highlights.h2.text: Set long-course world records at 400m in 2023 and 200m in 2025.
strings.timeline.t1.title: European 400m freestyle gold
strings.timeline.t1.text: Won 400m freestyle at the European championships in Paris.
strings.timeline.t2.title: 200m medley world record
strings.timeline.t2.text: Swam 1:52.69 in the Singapore worlds semi-final, setting a world record.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Four Paris Olympic golds
strings.timeline.t3.text: Won four individual titles at home and bronze in the men’s medley relay.
strings.timeline.t4.title: 400m medley world record
strings.timeline.t4.text: Swam 4:02.50 at the Fukuoka worlds, breaking Phelps’s record.
strings.timeline.t5.title: First two world golds
strings.timeline.t5.text: Won 200m and 400m medley titles at the Budapest worlds.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Moved to US training
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joined Arizona State and trained under Bowman.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Olympic debut
strings.timeline.t7.text: Finished sixth in Tokyo’s 400m medley, gaining major international experience.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Toulouse
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born into a swimming family; later began training at a Toulouse club.
